dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Three prominent elliptical 'O' structures on the lateral mid-section exhibit high-frequency serrated boundaries of light-intensity pixels surrounding dark-intensity interior centroids. The gradient transition at the outer perimeter is sharp, creating a distinct light-to-dark 'halo' effect.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low density of solid high-intensity pixel clusters concentrated in the anterior dorsal region; these clusters lack internal gradients and appear as asymmetrical, solid light-colored pixel masses.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest lateral 'O' structures form an obtuse triangle, while a secondary cluster of four smaller high-intensity blobs on the upper dorsal ridge forms a tight trapezoidal spatial relationship.

other_distinctive_markers: A complex interlocking network of macro-annuli creates a mesh-like 'chain-link' geometry across the highest point of the dorsal curve.
